range.remark: Pss 77-79, and Ps 80 vv.2-13. Ps 80 continues (v.14 to end) on pdf 96.

entries.emendation: אֶצְעָקָה (no waw, temporal); imperative for the second verb
entries.note: The verse turns on correctly parsing the second verb, which must be imperative rather than indicative; accordingly אצעקה (without the waw, per the versions) is temporal, and the doubled קולי אל אלהים is deliberate repetition (palilogy).
entries.flag: the exact grammatical reconstruction is garbled in OCR — verify at high res

entries.mt: בְּיוֹם צָרָתִי אֲדֹנָי דָּרָשְׁתִּי יָדִי לַיְלָה נִגְּרָה וְלֹא תָפוּג
entries.emendation: בְּיוֹם צָרָתִי דְּרַשְׁתִּיךָ אֲדֹנָי, וְלַיְלָה עֵינִי נִגְּרָה
entries.note: The verse needs an antithesis (day/night) as at Ps 22:3, 42:4, 88:2. ידי cannot be subject of נגרה — the hand does not 'flow', the eye does (already noted by Ibn Ganach); Targum guessed similarly. Read: the corrupted ידי is really the suffix of דרשתי (= דרשתיך), and עיני has dropped out before נגרה.
The verb אזכרה ('I remember') is disturbing — the suffering is present, why remember it? (Ps 42:5 already uses אזכרה in its proper place.) Leg. אזעקה 'I cry out'.
נפעמתי is doubtful; Pesch. חרשת ('was silent'), i.e. leg. נאלמתי 'I was struck dumb'.

entries.emendation: draw מקדם from v.7 into v.6; supply a verb (וְאֶזְכְּרָה) to open v.7
entries.note: As transmitted the verse lacks parallelism; the versions rightly draw מקדם from the following verse into this one (חשבתי ימים מקדם | שנות עולמים). Accordingly v.7 must open with a verb — LXX καὶ ἐμελέτησα, Pesch. — leg. something like ואזכרה. The Masoretic accents divide wrongly; עם לבבי still belongs to the first half.
entries.flag: the exact verb supplied for v.7 is garbled in OCR — verify at high res

entries.note: יחפש cannot be right, since חפש means only 'search', not 'muse, agonize'. Per the parallel Ps 143:5 (ותתעטף עלי רוחי, בתוכי ישתומם לבי), read here either ויתעטף or וישתומם רוחי (the noun רוח being used as either gender).

entries.mt: הֶאָפֵס לָנֶצַח חַסְדּוֹ גָּמַר אֹמֶר לְדֹר וָדֹר
entries.emendation: delete or isolate אמר: גָּמַר alone (Aramaic 'be finished')
entries.note: 'גמר אמר' — what promise is meant? Most LXX codices lack the word אמר; it appears to be a dittography, or גמר should be read alone (an Aramaism for 'to come to an end').

entries.mt: וָאֹמַר חַלּוֹתִי הִיא שְׁנוֹת יְמִין עֶלְיוֹן
entries.note: Comparing the parallel in Isaiah 63-65, where the same question — has God withheld His mercy? (63:15, cf. 64:11 העל אלה תתאפק ה׳, matching קפץ רחמיו here) — is answered by attributing the plight to the people's own guilt (65:7, 59:2): so here too the psalmist can only cite guilt as cause. Leg. עונתי היא statt חלותי. שנות ימין simply means 'the change, the alteration' (of the right hand).

entries.mt: אזכור (קרי) / אזכיר (כתיב) מַעַלְלֵי־יָהּ כִּי־אֶזְכְּרָה מִקֶּדֶם פִּלְאֲךָ
entries.emendation: prefer Ketib אזכיר; second אזכרה → אזמרה; כי → כן
entries.note: The Ketib אזכיר is more correct than the Qere אזכור. But then the following אזכרה in b. is disturbing; wohl leg. אזמרה, and statt כי leg. כן (as at Ps 61:9).
Dark as it stands; vielleicht leg. מקדם 'from of old' statt בקדש. The following 'מי אל גדול כאלהים' is parenthetical.
entries.flag: exact form garbled in OCR — verify at high res

entries.note: בני יעקב ויוסף סלה is not symmetrical to a. Symmetry is restored at once if one reads העלית statt סלה (confusion of ס/ע with a dropped consonant; cf. his identical emendation of a closing סלה at Ps 49:14, o. S. 340).

entries.mt: רָאוּךָ מַּיִם ... יָחִילוּ אַף יִרְגְּזוּ תְהֹמוֹת
entries.note: The parallel with Habakkuk 3:10-11 begins here; without deciding at a glance which passage is original and which borrowed, the readings of each may be used to correct the other. Here מים is probably not original, since it would be tautological with תהמות; there (Habakkuk) הרים is the more correct reading.
entries.flag: whether he actually proposes emending Ps 77:17's מים to הרים, or only notes the relationship, is unclear from the garbled OCR — verify at high res

entries.emendation: if Pual retained: מֵעָבוֹת (מ absorbed by the identical letter)
entries.note: If זרמו is Kal, then עבות is its subject (so Pesch. and, per Syro-Hexapla, Aquila: 'the clouds poured forth water'). But if the Masoretic Pual זרמו is kept, one would have to read מעבות, the מ absorbed by the following עבות. Unlike the parallel in Habakkuk 3:10 (מים עבר עבר, which makes no good sense), Ps 77's זרמו מים עבות is here the more correct reading.

Corresponds to the parallel in Hab 3:11 (לאור חציך יהלכו), which is secure there given its own parallel לנגה ברק חניתך. Possibly here אור was corrupted to אף and the ל before חצציך dropped; alternatively, if אף חצציך is original here, the psalmist deliberately altered his Habakkuk source.
בגלגל makes no sense; leg. כגלגל 'like the sound of a wheel' (cf. Ps 97:4, which has ברקיו for the parallel; Pesch. here likewise ברקיך).

entries.mt: אֶפְתְּחָה בְמָשָׁל פִּי אַבִּיעָה חִידוֹת מִנִּי־קֶדֶם
entries.note: משל here means neither 'parable' nor 'maxim' — not a single verse in this long psalm contains a poetic image or a pointed saying. The word must instead carry the general sense 'poetry, verse-composition' (cf. משלים used of epic poets). Nor can חידות mean 'riddle', since everything here is stated plainly. Wahrscheinlich leg. תורות 'teachings', to which the pronoun in v.3 then refers; otherwise the accompanying מני קדם ('riddles of old'?) is also unintelligible.
The participle מספרים is syntactically out of place; leg. נספרה (Pesch. נשתעא 'we will tell'), or supply the infinitive מספר after נכחד — though the ending ־ים then remains unaccounted for.

נשקי רומי קשת cannot be precisely explained, since the etymology of נשק itself is uncertain, though it clearly means 'weapon' in general (sword and spear, not specifically bow). For רומי read רובי, as רבה קשת (Gen 21:20, Ps 18:15) — an archaic word for drawing the bow and loosing arrows. The construct state before an adjective denotes a superlative (as יעצי פרעה): 'the most weapon-skilled of the [archers]'.

entries.mt: וַיּוֹסִיפוּ עוֹד לַחֲטֹא־לוֹ לַמְרוֹת עֶלְיוֹן בַּצִּיָּה
entries.emendation: לַמְרוֹת → a form of מרר, not מרה
entries.note: למרות cannot derive from מרה, which would require את פי as its object (absent here); nor is a transgressed command at issue, only faint-hearted disbelief. LXX render παρεπίκραναν; Pesch. reads a feminine infinitive of מרר. He applies the identical correction at v.40 (כמה ימרוהו), v.56 (וימרו את אלהים), Ps 106:33 (המרו את רוחו), and Isa 63:10 (leg. המרו) — there being two parallel Hiphil patterns, as הניח/הנוח from נוח.
הכריע ('bowed down') can derive neither from כרע by transposition nor be emended to הכניע — both would be too weak beside the preceding ויהרג ('slew'); rather leg. הכרית 'cut off, destroyed'.
Aquila renders ὡς ἀτμόν = כהבל 'like a breath', far more sensible than בהבל. Then בהלה (in the parallel half) can mean 'in haste', as the old versions render it (cf. Lev 26:16 בהלה = בבהלה).
It is striking that the object is appended as a bare noun after the pronoun already implied; Pesch. more correctly has אליו, the ו absorbed by the following word's initial letter.
LXX render with a suffix, ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν = עונם 'their guilt'.

entries.emendation: וינסו traced to אות via הואיתו → התאוו → וינסו
entries.note: וינסו is unintelligible as it stands; probably from אות 'sign' (Hiphil הואיתו), transposed to התאוו and contracted to וינסו — similarly perhaps 1 Sam 21:14 ויתו = ויתאו 'made a sign' (Targum ורשם).
entries.flag: the exact mechanics of the proposed derivation are garbled in OCR — verify at high res

entries.note: הרג ('slay') is never used of inanimate things; Pesch. suggests another verb, perhaps יגדע 'cut down'. The hapax legomenon חנמל is also uncertain — perhaps a miswriting of אלגביש 'hailstones'.
Leg. the Hiphil וַיַּסְגֵּר (so too Dyserinck); רשף means 'arrow' (cf. Ps 76:4) and is also used of plague-arrows.

entries.mt: עֶבְרָה וָזַעַם וְצָרָה מִשְׁלַחַת מַלְאֲכֵי רָעִים
entries.emendation: וְצָרָה → יְצַו(?); מִשְׁלַחַת → לְמַשְׁחִית(?); מַלְאֲכֵי רָעִים → מַלְאָכָיו רָעִים
entries.note: The verse has no parallel structure, and וצרה does not fit among the synonyms for wrath — wohl statt וצרה leg. יצו. משלחת ('a mission of evil angels'?) is likewise irregular and unique — wohl emend to למשחית 'to destroy'. The construction מלאכי רעים is un-Hebrew; leg. מלאכיו רעים 'His messengers of evil'.
LXX render πρωτότοκα αὐτῶν, i.e. reading אונם with a suffix.

entries.mt: וַיִּטֹּשׁ מִשְׁכַּן שִׁלוֹ אֹהֶל שִׁכֵּן בָּאָדָם
entries.note: באדם gives no good sense; leg. באפרים 'in Ephraim'.
LXX ἐπενθήθησαν 'lamented' (active sense); leg. the active הילילו, matching תבכינה in the following verse.
Targum renders דמתפקח ('awakening'); leg. accordingly מתעורר 'rousing himself' statt מתרונן.

entries.emendation: a noun-form from root בר (purity), parallel to תחנונה from חנן
entries.note: 'With the understanding of his hands' makes no sense — hands are not intelligent. A Greek translator (Theodotion or Symmachus) renders κατὰ καθαρότητα 'in purity', i.e. reading a form from the root בר (as in בור כפיו 'purity of hands'); this would be a distinct noun-form comparable to תחנונה beside החנון (from חנן).
אכל must be read as the plural אכלו (LXX ἔφαγον), matching the parallel Jer 10:25 (כי אכלו את יעקב). ואת נוהו refers to the Temple, as 2 Sam 15:25 (אתו ואת נוהו).
Leg. plural אסירים, per LXX τῶν πεπεδημένων; likewise at Isa 10:4 (כרע תחת אסיר) he takes אסיר as = אסירים, and Pesch. there has אסירא.
A participle must be supplied ('הלך לפני', 'who went before'), parallel to the two preceding participial phrases רעה ישראל and נהג כצאן יוסף (v.2) — all these participles carry perfect (past) force.
After אלהים supply צבאות, as in the parallel refrains (vv.8, 20).
One cannot properly say 'smoke/rage against a prayer' — one can rage against a person, not a prayer. Vielleicht leg. שתמת בתפלה, as Lam 3:8 שתם תפלתי 'He shut out my prayer'.

entries.mt: הֶאֱכַלְתָּם לֶחֶם דִּמְעָה וַתַּשְׁקֵמוֹ בִּדְמָעוֹת שָׁלִישׁ
entries.note: LXX and Symmachus render the verbs with first-person-plural suffixes (ἐψώμισας ἡμᾶς, ἐπότισας ἡμᾶς): leg. האכלתנו ... ותשקנו. And שליש (elsewhere only Isa 40:12, a large dry-measure) cannot be right — one cannot drink from a measure! Vielleicht leg. ראש 'venom' (as in ראש ומרורה).
Statt מדון LXX have ἀντιλογία, Pesch. likewise; wohl the more correct reading is מריבה.

כסו is a Pual form with short o (like מְאֳדָּמִים and similar verbs); accordingly one must read הרים מצלה 'the mountains [were covered] by its shade' (so Pesch. טורא מן טללה). ארזי אל are the cedars of Lebanon, 'planted by God'.

That ארה means 'to pluck' is not certain — Cant 5:1 (ארתי מורי עם בשמי) cannot mean 'plucked' either, since fragrance is smelled, not plucked (perhaps leg. הרחתי there, 'I have smelled'). Here Pesch. renders the verb by דש 'trampled', which also fits the overall sense better.
